The run consumed 203,538 reported tokens in 114 seconds, then escalated and asked the user to retry while also mentioning scheduler operation; a clearer bounded recovery policy should stop repeated exploration sooner, summarize the failed attempts and usage once, and give one state-appropriate next command.

It could be more context-efficient by treating the first missing-index semantic-search error as an immediate fallback signal rather than trying that unavailable index first; the implementation's copy is also more allocation-heavy than the fix's slice-capacity approach, though the hidden regression test and full suite pass.
